title: Reinforcement
description: Adds some reinforced blast-proof blocks, inspired by the HBM mod.
body:
# Reinforcememt

Adds reinforced blocks, such as reinforced concrete, stone bricks, glass, tinted glass, glowstone, and more. CTM support with Continuity!

Screenshots in the gallery, as well as the project icon.


<details>
<summary>Reinforced Blocks</summary>

- Reinforced Concrete (stair and slab varients as well)
- Reinforced Stone Bricks (stair and slab varients as well)
- Reinforced Glowstone
- Reinforced Glass
- Reinforced Tinted Glass
- Reinforced Iron Door
- Reinforced Iron Trapdoor
- Reinforced Iron Pressure Plate

</details>
  
  
  




  
PS: If anyone knows how to make pretty isometric renders of minecraft blocks like the icon on neoforge 1.21.1, PLEASE TELL ME.
